import SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsSpectralModels

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Set
open scoped Matrix

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsBalancedSensorReconstruction27
open CompleteFoundationsSpectralModels

def sensorH : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := !![1,1;1,-1]
def inverseH : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := !![1/2,1/2;1/2,-1/2]
def sensorErrors : Set E := {eta | |eta 0| ≤ 1/10 ∧ |eta 1| ≤ 1/10}
def reconstructedErrors : Set E := applyMatrix inverseH '' sensorErrors

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_both_matrix_inverse_identities :
    inverseH * sensorH = 1 ∧ sensorH * inverseH = 1 := by
  constructor <;> ext i j <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [sensorH,inverseH,Matrix.mul_apply,Fin.sum_univ_succ]

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_actual_matrix_inverse : sensorH⁻¹ = inverseH := by
  exact Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv actual_balanced_sensor_both_matrix_inverse_identities.1

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_coordinate_action (x : E) :
    applyMatrix sensorH x = point (x 0+x 1) (x 0-x 1) := by
  rw [matrix_coordinate_action]
  simp [sensorH,sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem actual_balanced_inverse_coordinate_action (eta : E) :
    applyMatrix inverseH eta = point ((eta 0+eta 1)/2) ((eta 0-eta 1)/2) := by
  rw [matrix_coordinate_action]
  simp [inverseH,sub_eq_add_neg]
  congr 1 <;> ring

theorem actual_balanced_inverse_cancels_every_sensor_vector (x : E) :
    applyMatrix inverseH (applyMatrix sensorH x) = x := by
  rw [actual_balanced_inverse_coordinate_action,actual_balanced_sensor_coordinate_action]
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [point] <;> ring

theorem actual_balanced_source_estimate_and_measurements :
    applyMatrix inverseH (point 6 2) = point 4 2 ∧
    applyMatrix sensorH (point 4 2) = point 6 2 := by
  rw [actual_balanced_inverse_coordinate_action,actual_balanced_sensor_coordinate_action]
  norm_num [point]

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_noisy_reconstruction_error (z eta : E) :
    applyMatrix (sensorH⁻¹) (applyMatrix sensorH z + eta)-z =
      applyMatrix inverseH eta := by
  rw [actual_balanced_sensor_actual_matrix_inverse,map_add,
    actual_balanced_inverse_cancels_every_sensor_vector,add_sub_cancel_left]

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_euclidean_squares (x : E) :
    ‖applyMatrix sensorH x‖^2 = 2*‖x‖^2 ∧
    ‖applyMatrix inverseH x‖^2 = ‖x‖^2/2 := by
  rw [actual_balanced_sensor_coordinate_action,actual_balanced_inverse_coordinate_action]
  simp only [norm_squared_coordinates,point,PiLp.toLp_apply,Matrix.cons_val_zero,Matrix.cons_val_one]
  constructor <;> ring

theorem actual_balanced_reconstructed_error_exact_norm (eta : E) :
    ‖applyMatrix inverseH eta‖ = ‖eta‖/Real.sqrt 2 := by
  have hs := actual_balanced_sensor_euclidean_squares eta |>.2
  have hr : (Real.sqrt 2)^2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hp : 0 < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have he : (‖eta‖/Real.sqrt 2)^2=‖eta‖^2/2 := by
    rw [div_pow,hr]
  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hp.le)).mp (hs.trans he.symm)

theorem actual_balanced_bounded_sensors_give_tenth_error (eta : E)
    (h : eta ∈ sensorErrors) : ‖applyMatrix inverseH eta‖ ≤ 1/10 := by
  have h0 := sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg (eta 0)) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/10) |>.mpr h.1
  have h1 := sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg (eta 1)) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/10) |>.mpr h.2
  have hs := actual_balanced_sensor_euclidean_squares eta |>.2
  rw [norm_squared_coordinates eta] at hs
  rw [sq_abs] at h0 h1
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (applyMatrix inverseH eta)]

theorem actual_balanced_error_set_is_the_rotated_square (e : E) :
    e∈reconstructedErrors ↔ |e 0+e 1|≤1/10 ∧ |e 0-e 1|≤1/10 := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨eta,h,rfl⟩
    rw [actual_balanced_inverse_coordinate_action]
    change |(eta 0+eta 1)/2+(eta 0-eta 1)/2|≤1/10 ∧
      |(eta 0+eta 1)/2-(eta 0-eta 1)/2|≤1/10
    have h0 : (eta 0+eta 1)/2+(eta 0-eta 1)/2=eta 0 := by ring
    have h1 : (eta 0+eta 1)/2-(eta 0-eta 1)/2=eta 1 := by ring
    simpa only [sensorErrors,Set.mem_setOf_eq,h0,h1] using h
  · intro h
    refine ⟨applyMatrix sensorH e,?_,actual_balanced_inverse_cancels_every_sensor_vector e⟩
    rw [actual_balanced_sensor_coordinate_action]
    exact h

theorem actual_balanced_error_coordinate_bound_and_forced_zero (e : E)
    (h : e∈reconstructedErrors) : |e 0|≤1/10 ∧
      (|e 0|=1/10 → e 1=0) := by
  have hr := actual_balanced_error_set_is_the_rotated_square e |>.mp h
  rcases abs_le.mp hr.1 with ⟨a,b⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hr.2 with ⟨c,d⟩
  constructor
  · apply abs_le.mpr; constructor <;> linarith
  · intro he
    by_cases hp : 0 ≤ e 0
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hp] at he; linarith
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos (le_of_not_ge hp)] at he; linarith

theorem actual_balanced_reconstructed_errors_have_sensor_corner_images :
    applyMatrix inverseH (point (1/10) (1/10)) = point (1/10) 0 ∧
    applyMatrix inverseH (point (-1/10) (-1/10)) = point (-1/10) 0 ∧
    applyMatrix inverseH (point (1/10) (-1/10)) = point 0 (1/10) ∧
    applyMatrix inverseH (point (-1/10) (1/10)) = point 0 (-1/10) := by
  simp only [actual_balanced_inverse_coordinate_action]
  norm_num [point]

theorem actual_balanced_reconstructed_errors_are_not_independent_coordinate_box :
    point (1/10) (1/10) ∉ reconstructedErrors := by
  rw [actual_balanced_error_set_is_the_rotated_square]
  norm_num [point]

theorem actual_balanced_true_displacement_maximum :
    IsGreatest {v : ℝ | ∃e∈reconstructedErrors,v=4-e 0} (41/10) := by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨point (-1/10) 0,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [actual_balanced_error_set_is_the_rotated_square]
      norm_num [point]
    · norm_num [point]
  · rintro v ⟨e,he,rfl⟩
    have h := actual_balanced_error_coordinate_bound_and_forced_zero e he |>.1
    have hl := abs_le.mp h |>.1
    linarith

theorem actual_balanced_fixture_upper_limit_decisions :
    (∀e∈reconstructedErrors,4-e 0≤83/20) ∧
      (∃e∈reconstructedErrors,81/20<4-e 0) := by
  constructor
  · intro e he
    have h := actual_balanced_true_displacement_maximum.2 ⟨e,he,rfl⟩
    linarith
  · obtain ⟨e,he,hv⟩ := actual_balanced_true_displacement_maximum.1
    exact ⟨e,he,by linarith⟩

end SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsBalancedSensorReconstruction27

open Set

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsBalancedSensorSpectral27
open CompleteFoundationsSpectralModels

def sensorH : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := !![1,1;1,-1]
def sensorLin : E →ₗ[ℝ] E := sensorH.toEuclideanLin
def spectralConditionNumber : ℝ := sensorLin.singularValues 0 / sensorLin.singularValues 1

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_matrix_action (x : E) :
    applyMatrix sensorH x = point (x 0+x 1) (x 0-x 1) := by
  rw [matrix_coordinate_action]
  simp [sensorH,sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_source_measurements :
    applyMatrix sensorH (point 4 2) = point 6 2 := by
  rw [actual_balanced_sensor_matrix_action]
  norm_num [point]

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_transpose_gram :
    sensorH.transpose * sensorH = (2 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) := by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [sensorH,Matrix.transpose_apply,Matrix.mul_apply,Fin.sum_univ_succ]

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_quadratic_identity (x : E) :
    inner ℝ x (applyMatrix (sensorH.transpose * sensorH) x) = 2*‖x‖^2 := by
  rw [actual_balanced_sensor_transpose_gram,matrix_coordinate_action,inner_coordinate_formula,
    norm_squared_coordinates]
  simp [point]
  ring

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_exact_squared_stretch (x : E) :
    ‖applyMatrix sensorH x‖^2 = 2*‖x‖^2 := by
  rw [actual_balanced_sensor_matrix_action]
  simp only [norm_squared_coordinates,point,PiLp.toLp_apply,Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one]
  ring

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_exact_norm_stretch (x : E) :
    ‖applyMatrix sensorH x‖ = Real.sqrt 2*‖x‖ := by
  have hs := actual_balanced_sensor_exact_squared_stretch x
  have hr : (Real.sqrt 2)^2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))).mp
  rw [mul_pow,hr]
  exact hs

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_adjoint_gram :
    sensorLin.adjoint.comp sensorLin = (2 : ℝ) • LinearMap.id := by
  have ht : sensorH.conjTranspose = sensorH := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [sensorH,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  unfold sensorLin
  rw [← Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint,ht]
  ext x i
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply,LinearMap.smul_apply,LinearMap.id_apply]
  change (applyMatrix sensorH (applyMatrix sensorH x)) i = (2 • x) i
  rw [actual_balanced_sensor_matrix_action,actual_balanced_sensor_matrix_action]
  fin_cases i <;> simp [point] <;> ring

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_all_genuine_singular_values (i : ℕ) :
    sensorLin.singularValues i = if i < 2 then Real.sqrt 2 else 0 := by
  have hd : Module.finrank ℝ E = 2 := by
    simp [E]
  by_cases hi : i < 2
  · rw [if_pos hi]
    have hEig := sensorLin.hasEigenvalue_adjoint_comp_self_sq_singularValues (by simpa [hd] using hi)
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hEig.exists_hasEigenvector
    have hne : x ≠ 0 := (Module.End.hasEigenvector_iff.mp hx).2
    have he := hx.apply_eq_smul
    rw [actual_balanced_sensor_adjoint_gram] at he
    simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply,LinearMap.id_apply] at he
    have hz : (2 - sensorLin.singularValues i ^ 2) • x = 0 := by
      change 2 • x = sensorLin.singularValues i ^ 2 • x at he
      rw [sub_smul,he,sub_self]
    have hsq : sensorLin.singularValues i ^ 2 = 2 := by
      have hh := (smul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_right hne
      linarith
    exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (sensorLin.singularValues_nonneg i) (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2)).mp
      (hsq.trans (Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)).symm)
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    exact sensorLin.singularValues_of_finrank_le (by simpa [hd] using Nat.le_of_not_gt hi)

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_both_singular_values_and_condition_number :
    sensorLin.singularValues 0 = Real.sqrt 2 ∧
    sensorLin.singularValues 1 = Real.sqrt 2 ∧ spectralConditionNumber = 1 := by
  have h0 := actual_balanced_sensor_all_genuine_singular_values 0
  have h1 := actual_balanced_sensor_all_genuine_singular_values 1
  norm_num at h0 h1
  refine ⟨h0,h1,?_⟩
  rw [spectralConditionNumber,h0,h1]
  exact div_self (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)).ne'

theorem actual_balanced_sensor_every_unit_direction_has_the_same_stretch
    (x y : E) (hx : ‖x‖=1) (hy : ‖y‖=1) :
    ‖applyMatrix sensorH x‖ = Real.sqrt 2 ∧
    ‖applyMatrix sensorH y‖ = Real.sqrt 2 ∧
    ‖applyMatrix sensorH x‖ = ‖applyMatrix sensorH y‖ := by
  simp [actual_balanced_sensor_exact_norm_stretch,hx,hy]

end SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsBalancedSensorSpectral27

open Set

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsResidualOrthogonality27

variable {V W : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup W] [InnerProductSpace ℝ W] [CompleteSpace W]

def loss (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (y : W) (x : V) : ℝ := ‖A x-y‖^2

theorem actual_residual_two_sided_perturbation_expansion
    (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (y : W) (x v : V) (t : ℝ) :
    loss A y (x+t • v) = loss A y x +
      2*t*inner ℝ (A x-y) (A v)+t^2*‖A v‖^2 := by
  have he : A (x+t • v)-y = (A x-y)+t • A v := by
    rw [map_add,map_smul]
    abel
  rw [loss,he,norm_add_sq_real]
  simp only [real_inner_smul_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,mul_pow,sq_abs,loss]
  ring

theorem actual_global_minimum_forces_every_residual_inner_product_zero
    (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (y : W) (x : V)
    (hmin : ∀z : V,loss A y x ≤ loss A y z) (v : V) :
    inner ℝ (A x-y) (A v) = 0 := by
  have hq : ∀t : ℝ,0 ≤ ‖A v‖^2*(t*t)+
      (2*inner ℝ (A x-y) (A v))*t+0 := by
    intro t
    have h := hmin (x+t • v)
    rw [actual_residual_two_sided_perturbation_expansion] at h
    nlinarith
  have hd := discrim_le_zero hq
  simp only [discrim,mul_zero,sub_zero] at hd
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (inner ℝ (A x-y) (A v))]

theorem actual_normal_equation_iff_residual_perpendicular_to_whole_range
    (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (y : W) (x : V) :
    A.adjoint (A x-y)=0 ↔ ∀v : V,inner ℝ (A x-y) (A v)=0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h v
    rw [← A.adjoint_inner_left v (A x-y),h,inner_zero_left]
  · intro h
    apply (inner_self_eq_zero (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp
    rw [A.adjoint_inner_left]
    exact h (A.adjoint (A x-y))

theorem actual_normal_equation_gives_exact_global_loss_difference
    (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (y : W) (x : V)
    (hx : A.adjoint (A x-y)=0) (z : V) :
    loss A y z = loss A y x + ‖A (z-x)‖^2 := by
  have ho := (actual_normal_equation_iff_residual_perpendicular_to_whole_range A y x).mp hx
  have he := actual_residual_two_sided_perturbation_expansion A y x (z-x) 1
  simp only [one_smul,add_sub_cancel,one_pow,mul_one,ho,mul_zero,add_zero] at he
  simpa using he

theorem actual_least_squares_global_minimum_iff_normal_equation
    (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (y : W) (x : V) :
    (∀z : V,loss A y x ≤ loss A y z) ↔ A.adjoint (A x-y)=0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (actual_normal_equation_iff_residual_perpendicular_to_whole_range A y x).mpr
    exact actual_global_minimum_forces_every_residual_inner_product_zero A y x h
  · intro h z
    rw [actual_normal_equation_gives_exact_global_loss_difference A y x h z]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _)

theorem actual_independent_columns_gram_is_strictly_positive
    (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (hA : Function.Injective A) (v : V) (hv : v≠0) :
    0 < inner ℝ v (A.adjoint (A v)) := by
  rw [A.adjoint_inner_right,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hn : A v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hv
    apply hA
    simpa using h
  exact sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hn)

theorem actual_independent_columns_make_the_normal_equation_solution_unique
    (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (hA : Function.Injective A) (y : W) (x : V)
    (hx : A.adjoint (A x-y)=0) (z : V) :
    loss A y z = loss A y x ↔ z=x := by
  rw [actual_normal_equation_gives_exact_global_loss_difference A y x hx z]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hs : ‖A (z-x)‖^2=0 := by linarith
    have hn : ‖A (z-x)‖=0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (A (z-x))]
    have hz : A (z-x)=0 := norm_eq_zero.mp hn
    have hzx : z-x=0 := hA (by simpa using hz)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hzx
  · rintro rfl
    simp

theorem actual_finite_dimensional_independent_columns_have_one_attained_minimum
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (hA : Function.Injective A) (y : W) :
    ∃!x : V,∀z : V,loss A y x ≤ loss A y z := by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (A.adjoint.comp A).toLinearMap :=
    A.adjoint_comp_self_injective_iff.mpr hA
  have hsurj := LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hsurj (A.adjoint y)
  have hn : A.adjoint (A x-y)=0 := by
    rw [map_sub]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hx
  refine ⟨x,(actual_least_squares_global_minimum_iff_normal_equation A y x).mpr hn,?_⟩
  intro z hz
  apply (actual_independent_columns_make_the_normal_equation_solution_unique A hA y x hn z).mp
  exact le_antisymm (hz x)
    ((actual_least_squares_global_minimum_iff_normal_equation A y x).mpr hn z)

theorem actual_independent_matrix_columns_give_positive_definite_transpose_gram
    {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (H : Matrix m n ℝ) (hH : Function.Injective H.mulVec) :
    (H.transpose*H).PosDef := by
  have ht : H.conjTranspose=H.transpose := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  rw [← ht]
  refine Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos (Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self H) ?_
  intro x hx
  rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec,Matrix.vecMul_conjTranspose,star_star]
  apply Matrix.dotProduct_star_self_pos_iff.mpr
  intro hz
  apply hx
  apply hH
  simpa using hz

end SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsResidualOrthogonality27


namespace SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsResidualOrthogonality27
variable {V W : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup W] [InnerProductSpace ℝ W] [CompleteSpace W]

theorem actual_residual_direction_derivative_follows_from_expansion
    (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (y : W) (x v : V) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => loss A y (x+t • v))
      (2*inner ℝ (A x-y) (A v)) 0 := by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (loss A y x)).add
    ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).const_mul (2*inner ℝ (A x-y) (A v)))).add
    (((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).pow 2).const_mul (‖A v‖^2))
  convert h using 1
  · funext t
    change loss A y (x+t • v) = loss A y x + (2*inner ℝ (A x-y) (A v))*t + ‖A v‖^2*t^2
    rw [actual_residual_two_sided_perturbation_expansion]
    ring
  · norm_num

theorem actual_every_local_minimum_has_a_residual_perpendicular_to_whole_range
    (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (y : W) (x : V) (hx : IsLocalMin (loss A y) x) :
    ∀v : V,inner ℝ (A x-y) (A v)=0 := by
  intro v
  have hc : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => x+t • v) 0 := by fun_prop
  have hl : IsLocalMin (loss A y) ((fun t : ℝ => x+t • v) 0) := by simpa using hx
  have hlocal : IsLocalMin (fun t : ℝ => loss A y (x+t • v)) 0 :=
    IsLocalMin.comp_continuous (g := fun t : ℝ => x+t • v) hl hc
  have hd := hlocal.hasDerivAt_eq_zero
    (actual_residual_direction_derivative_follows_from_expansion A y x v)
  linarith

theorem actual_local_least_squares_minimum_is_already_a_global_minimum
    (A : V →L[ℝ] W) (y : W) (x : V) (hx : IsLocalMin (loss A y) x) :
    ∀z : V,loss A y x ≤ loss A y z := by
  apply (actual_least_squares_global_minimum_iff_normal_equation A y x).mpr
  apply (actual_normal_equation_iff_residual_perpendicular_to_whole_range A y x).mpr
  exact actual_every_local_minimum_has_a_residual_perpendicular_to_whole_range A y x hx

end SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsResidualOrthogonality27


namespace SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsMatrixResidualBridge27
open CompleteFoundationsResidualOrthogonality27
variable {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]

def matrixOperator (H : Matrix m n ℝ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ n →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ m :=
  H.toEuclideanLin.toContinuousLinearMap

theorem actual_rectangular_matrix_operator_action
    (H : Matrix m n ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    matrixOperator H x = WithLp.toLp 2 (H *ᵥ (x : n → ℝ)) := by
  rfl

theorem actual_rectangular_matrix_adjoint_is_the_actual_transpose_action
    (H : Matrix m n ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) :
    (matrixOperator H).adjoint y = WithLp.toLp 2 (H.transpose *ᵥ (y : m → ℝ)) := by
  have ht : H.conjTranspose=H.transpose := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  rw [matrixOperator,←LinearMap.adjoint_toContinuousLinearMap,
    ←Matrix.toEuclideanLin_conjTranspose_eq_adjoint,ht]
  rfl

theorem actual_matrix_squared_residual_is_the_generic_loss
    (H : Matrix m n ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (H *ᵥ (x : n → ℝ)) - y‖^2 = loss (matrixOperator H) y x := by
  rfl

theorem actual_matrix_least_squares_normal_equation_is_exactly_transpose_residual_zero
    (H : Matrix m n ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ m) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ n) :
    (∀z : EuclideanSpace ℝ n,
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (H *ᵥ (x : n → ℝ))-y‖^2 ≤
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (H *ᵥ (z : n → ℝ))-y‖^2) ↔
      H.transpose *ᵥ (H *ᵥ (x : n → ℝ)-(y : m → ℝ))=0 := by
  simp_rw [actual_matrix_squared_residual_is_the_generic_loss]
  rw [actual_least_squares_global_minimum_iff_normal_equation,
    actual_rectangular_matrix_adjoint_is_the_actual_transpose_action,
    actual_rectangular_matrix_operator_action]
  constructor
  · intro h
